title: From Facts to Folklore: Evaluating Large Language Models on Bengali Cultural Knowledge
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge of Bengali cultural terms and concepts related to religion.
findings: In Question Answering tasks, models generally underperformed on cultural categories compared to non-cultural ones. However, 'Religion' was an exception, alongside 'Food', where models performed better than in other cultural categories like 'Entertainment', 'People', and 'Historical'.
